review_scope: Second-round independent review of the corrected Writer draft. I re-opened every remote source live (registry manifests, four HF configs, model card, Ollama FAQ and api.md, internal links) and re-read the bound first-party records. Article, schema and images were not modified; only this receipt and research/<slug>-review.json changed.

claims.note: Headline and description name the three documented subjects: registry layer packaging, the computed image-token cost and the documented 4096-token default; no measured claim is asserted in either string. Both strings equal the schema partial verbatim.
Scope paragraph: date of the observations, the CPU-only host, and the explicit limit that the 32B row is metadata and arithmetic only. No figure beyond the observation date.

404-versus-manifest pair re-checked in this run at 2026-11-03T17:06:38Z: the qwen3vl path returned HTTP 404 and the hyphenated qwen3-vl path returned a manifest. Limited to the registry manifest endpoint.

Control: 46 prompt tokens with the image against 41 without it, 5-token delta read as an image marker only; both requests returned HTTP 200 and the same 'cannot see the image' reply. Limitation: the with-image request stores no prompt string of its own, so prompt identity rests on the record's note 'same prompt, no image'; the conclusion does not depend on exact prompt equality because 46 is far below the 300-token grid.

claims.note: 330 prompt tokens with one 640x480 image against 28 for the same 85-character question with no image, both HTTP 200; the counts are prompt_eval_count from the paired rerun, not an accuracy result.

run.methodology: Two POST /api/chat requests on qwen3-vl:2b Q4_K_M at num_ctx=4096, num_predict=32, temperature=0 on the same CPU-only 2 vCPU host, using one 1956-byte 640x480 PNG and the identical 85-character question with and without the image; prompt_eval_count, eval_count, elapsed seconds, done_reason, response and thinking recorded in one JSON trace. The earlier trace with a differently worded baseline is kept in raw/runtime_trace_partial.json.

Packaging comparison across qwen3-vl sizes with the sizes rounded from the manifests (839325984 B and 1162568672 B). The paragraph explicitly refuses the capability inference.

claims.note: Withdraws the original 'no projector layer means text-only' premise for the 2B and states why: the model card describes a conditional-generation vision-language checkpoint and the manifest layer list alone cannot establish runtime capability. No replacement claim about the 4B, 8B or 32B runtime is made.
patch_size 16, spatial_merge_size 2 and head_dim 128 plus the per-size layer counts are read from the four config.json files; the token formula is applied to those fields, not to a vendor statement.

KV bytes per token computed as 2 x layers x kv_heads x head_dim x 2 at f16 from the configs, using the formula credited to the site's text KV guide; the image-token arithmetic is the addition, not a re-derivation of the text case.

Table arithmetic recomputed this run: 112/144/144/256 KiB per token and 32.8/42.2/42.2/75 MiB at 300 tokens, 112/144/144/256 MiB at 1024, 175/225/225/400 MiB at 1600. Arithmetic only; nothing in the table was measured.
1600/4096 = 39.1% and 1600 x 262144 B = 400 MiB; 20910274496 B is 19.47 GiB and 400 MiB is about 2.0% of it. Both are computed from the config fields and the manifest size.

2304 divided by the 2x2 merge is 576, presented as an inferred ceiling rather than a documented property; 1600/576 = 2.78x holds only under that inference, and the paragraph keeps the statement that no request above 640x480 ran.

Paired rerun re-checked in this review: runtime_pair_q1.json records prompt_chars 85 in BOTH requests, prompt_eval_count 28 without the image and 330 with the 1956-byte 640x480 PNG (44.4 s and 115.7 s), delta 302 against 300 computed = 0.67%. The earlier 34-character baseline (18 tokens) is disclosed and excluded from the delta.

claims.note: Section heading naming the documented default that the section then quote-verifies; the digit refers to the FAQ sentence cited one paragraph below.
The 4096 default is quoted from the Ollama FAQ, re-opened in this run at 2026-11-03T17:06:38Z, which states 'By default, Ollama uses a context window size of 4096 tokens'.
3200/4096 = 78.1% and 4096-3200 = 896 tokens, computed from 1600 tokens per 1280x1280 image and the documented default. Labelled as a budget calculation, not as a failed request.
256 KiB x 4096 = 1024 MiB and x 16384 = 4096 MiB; 256 KiB x 1000 = 250 MiB; 19.47 GiB is the 32B manifest model layer. All arithmetic from the config fields and the observed manifest size.

Step 1 prints the layer media types and sizes of the tag and then reads the runtime capability list; both commands are the ones used for the figures above, with the registry URL verified live this run.
Step 2 describes the paired /api/chat request shape the trace used and names prompt_eval_count as the field to compare; it asserts no measurement itself.
Step 3 is the grid formula from the config geometry, 640x480 giving 300; it is a one-line arithmetic check, not a claim about runtime behaviour.

Reading guide for the three outcomes: zero delta means the pixels were dropped, delta near the grid means a real tokenized image, and a delta above the grid means the runtime rescaled or padded. Interpretation of the same two fields.
Limitations state which tags were and were not executed and why (32B model layer of 19.47 GiB against about 10 GiB free disk), plus the single-host, single-version and single-image-size bounds.

Restates the unreported 0.67% cause, the ceiling as an inference rather than a documented limit, the untested llama-server --mmproj path and the manifest-endpoint-only 404 check; no new figure is introduced.

Reader-access boundary: private local captures are not published, registry/config/arithmetic are reproducible from the linked endpoints, and the 28/330/46/41 prompt-token counts are one-host, one-version observations rather than a benchmark.

numbers.note: Every digit traces to a live registry manifest layer size, a config field re-fetched this run, the paired runtime trace, or arithmetic recomputed in this review: 330-28=302; 302/300=0.67%; KV/token 114688/147456/147456/262144 B; 1600/4096=39.1%; 3200/4096=78.1%; 400 MiB of 19.47 GiB is 2.0%.
